comment: Approved new-rule numbers as validated data (framework contract sections: Mana and Stamina, Weight Class and Dodge Roll, Unarmed fallback, Deck composition). No formula constant lives in code.

weight.capacityBaseNote: Was 50, then 5. Validated by tools/weightclass-census.mjs (2026-09-01), which measures every creatable start (each hand chosen independently, empty allowed) and, for reachability, every ordered pair of DISTINCT armaments through a real run loadout with the outfit at its highest Smithing tier (+1 poise threshold, so +1 weight). Base 50 left even the heaviest reachable kit at 34-40% (Light): no loadout could leave Light and the class did not exist for the player. Base 5 (the first retune) leaves the Rogue unable to reach Heavy (72% with warhammer + tower shield + Shadow+1; Reaver 80%, Starseer 81%, Herald 84% just reach it). Bases 0 and 1 are the only ones at which every class can reach Heavy; 0 is chosen because capacity is then exactly 2*CON + STR with no free constant (Reaver 91%, Starseer 96%, Rogue 83%, Herald 100%). At 0, 290 of 336 creatable starts are Light, 46 Medium, none Heavy.
